results.name: Band Crunch
steps: Place the band at the highest anchor point you have available. Grab both ends of the band and fall into a kneeling position.
Push your hips back flexing at the spine.
Squeeze your abs and then extend at the hips and spine back to the starting position.

results.name: Mini Band Leg Raise
steps: Loop band around ankles, lie flat on back.
Raise both legs upward, keeping them straight.
Lower slowly without arching lower back.

results.name: Mini Band Walking Mountain Climber
steps: Loop band around feet, start in high plank.
Step one foot forward under torso.
Alternate steps continuously, keeping hips stable.

results.name: Mini Band Mountain Climber
steps: Loop band around feet, start in high plank.
Drive one knee toward chest against resistance.
Alternate legs quickly while keeping hips stable.

results.name: Mini Band Around The World Plank
steps: Loop band around wrists, hold high plank position.
Move one hand forward, outward, then back in circular pattern.
Alternate sides, keeping hips level and core braced.

results.name: Mini Band Scissor Kick
steps: Loop band around ankles, lie on back.
Lift legs slightly off floor, core braced.
Alternate legs in controlled scissor motion.

results.name: Mini Band Plank Hand Step Out
steps: Loop band around wrists, hold high plank.
Step one hand outward against band tension.
Return and alternate, keeping hips level.

results.name: Mini Band Plank Step Out
steps: Loop band around ankles, hold high plank.
Step one foot outward, resisting band pull.
Return and alternate, maintaining stable hips.

results.name: Band Bayesian Curl
steps: Attach band to a low anchor point. Point your palms straight forward.
Flex your elbow until you feel your biceps contract. Then fully extend elbows.

results.name: Band Row
steps: Stand on your band with both feet.
Hinge forward at the hips while keeping a flat back.
Let your arms hang freely, then pull your elbows straight back toward the ceiling.

results.name: Band Kneeling Single Arm Pulldown
steps: Place the band at about eye level. Fall into a kneeling position.
The knee that is on the ground should be the same side as the working arm. Stick your chest out.
And then pull your elbow straight back. Flex your lats and then extend into the starting position.

results.name: Band Bayesian Hammer Curl
steps: Attach band to a low anchor point. Use a neutral grip.
Flex your elbow until you feel your biceps contract. Then fully extend elbows.

results.name: Band Bayesian Reverse Curl
steps: Attach band to a low anchor point. . Point your palms toward your thighs.
Flex your elbow until you feel your biceps contract. Then fully extend elbows.

results.name: Band High Curl
steps: Anchor a band to a high point.
Start with your feet staggered and your elbows high.
Flex your elbows while keeping your arms high. Curl the band to your forehead.

results.name: Band High Hammer Curl
steps: Start with the band anchored to something high with your feet staggered and a neutral grip.
Keep your elbows high. Curl until your fists are at your forehead.

results.name: Band High Reverse Curl
steps: Start with a band attached to a high point, your feet staggered, and an overhand grip.
Flex your elbows pulling your forearms to your biceps. Your fists should land by your forehead.

results.name: Band Curl
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, with the band under both feet.
Grasp the handles of the band with both hands, keeping your arms straight and extended in front of you.
Keep your back straight, abs engaged, and shoulders relaxed as you curl your hands towards your shoulders, bending at the elbows.

results.name: Band Reverse Curl
steps: Start by standing on the center of the band with both feet, shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band with both hands, palms facing down, arms extended straight in front of you.
Slowly curl your hands towards your shoulders, pulling the band tight, then lower your arms back to the starting position, keeping tension on the band throughout the exercise.

results.name: Band Squat Hold Single Arm Row
steps: Anchor the band to a stable point and take a half squat position.
Hold the band loop in one hand and pull your elbow straight back.

results.name: Band Squat Hold Row
steps: Anchor the band to a stable point.
Take a half squat position and hold there.
Perform a row while holding the squat position.

results.name: Band Single Arm Pulldown
steps: Anchor the band to a high point. Go into a seated position.
Grab the loop of the band and pull your upper arm to your side.

results.name: Band Single Arm Row
steps: Anchor band to a stable point.
Step back until there is no slack in the band and hold the end of the band with one hand.
Pull through the elbow straight back.

results.name: Band Single Arm Bent Over Row
steps: Stand on band and hinge at hips, holding handle with arm extended.
Pull elbow toward your hip, keeping back flat and shoulders square.
Squeeze back at the top, then lower slowly to full stretch.

results.name: Band Bent Over Row
steps: Stand on band with feet hip-width, holding handles with palms facing in.
Hinge at hips, keeping back flat and elbows close to ribs.
Pull handles toward torso, squeeze back, then lower slowly with control.

results.name: Band Pull Around
steps: Stand sideways to anchor and hold band with arm slightly extended.
Pull arm across your body in a smooth arc without rotating torso.
Squeeze chest at end range, then return slowly with control.

results.name: Mini Band Bent Over Row
steps: Stand on band, hinge forward with flat back.
Lower under control, maintaining core tension.

results.name: Mini Band Kneeling Row
steps: Anchor band around foot, kneel tall holding ends.
Row elbow back, squeezing shoulder blades together.
Return slowly, maintaining upright torso.

results.name: Band Calf Raise
steps: Attach band to a low anchor point.
Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Lean back slightly. Raise your heels straight up and down

results.name: Band Pushup
steps: Loop the band around your mid-back. The ends of the bands should be around your hands between your thumb and pointer finger.
This exercise can be done from the knees or the toes depending on experience level.
Begin by breaking at the elbows until your upper arm is by your side. Then extend at the elbows back into the top position.

results.name: Band Single Arm Pec Fly
steps: Attach the band to an anchor point that is about shoulder height. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Extend your shoulder joint and bring your arm across your body until you feel a contraction in your pecs.

results.name: Band Single Arm Internally Rotated Chest Fly
steps: Stand sideways to anchor, hold band with arm slightly bent and palm turned inward.
Bring arm across chest in a sweeping arc while keeping internal rotation.
Squeeze chest at end range, then return slowly under control.

results.name: Band Press Around
steps: Stand with band behind you and hold loop at chest height.
Press one arm forward and across your body in a sweeping arc.
Squeeze chest at full extension, then return slowly and switch sides.

results.name: Band Internally Rotated Chest Fly
steps: Start with both feet hip-width apart and step on the middle of the band with both feet. Hold the handles of the band in each hand and position the band above your chest, with your palms facing down.

Keeping your elbows slightly bent, slowly raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel with the floor. Make sure to internally rotate your shoulder joints by bringing your shoulder blades together and rotating your forearms inward towards your torso.
Hold the position for a few seconds and then slowly lower your arms back to the starting position, keeping the internal rotation of your shoulder joints throughout the movement.

results.name: Band Standing Chest Press
steps: Loop the band around your back. The two end loops in each of your hands.
Extend your shoulder joint and elbow across your body until your arm is fully extended.

results.name: Band Floor Press
steps: Lie on your back holding band loops with elbows resting on the floor.
Press arms straight up until elbows extend without locking.
Lower elbows back to floor under control, keeping tension throughout.

results.name: Band Bench Fly
steps: Lie on bench holding band handles with arms extended above chest.
Lower arms out wide in a controlled arc, keeping slight bend in elbows.
Bring arms back together over chest, squeezing pecs at the top.

results.name: Band Bench Press
steps: Lie on bench with band looped behind your back.
Lower hands toward chest while keeping elbows at a comfortable angle.
Press upward and squeeze chest at the top, maintaining band tension.

results.name: Band Front Raise
steps: Stand on the band with one or
feet depending on how heavy you want the band to be.
With your elbows extended raise your fists straight up to the ceiling until they are at eye level.

results.name: Mini Band Bent Arm Lateral Raise
steps: Loop band around elbows, arms bent
degrees at sides.
Raise both elbows outward to shoulder height.
Lower slowly and alternate, keeping tension on band.

results.name: Mini Band Alternating Bent Arm Lateral Raise
steps: Loop band around elbows, arms bent
degrees at sides.
Raise one elbow outward to shoulder height.
Lower slowly and alternate, keeping tension on band.

results.name: Mini Band Clock Tap
steps: Loop band around ankles, stand tall on one leg.
Tap opposite foot forward, side, then back.
Maintain balance and hip stability throughout movement.

results.name: Band Upright Row
steps: Stand with one or both feet on one end of a band. Take a double overhand roughly shoulder width grip.
Pull your elbows straight up the ceiling. Aim to get the band to chin level or slightly higher.

results.name: Band Single Arm Lateral Raise
steps: Stand on band and hold handle or loop at your side with slight elbow bend.
Raise arm out to the side until shoulder height, keeping torso still.
Lower slowly under control, maintaining constant tension on the delt.

results.name: Band Squat
steps: Stand with a shoulder width grip. Both feet should be on the band with the band loops in each of your hand.
Push your butt back and also break at the knees.
Try to hit parallel depth (bottom of your leg should be parallel with the ground). If you can't tell your squat depth, then try squatting in front of a mirror and watch your form.

results.name: Band Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand on your band with both feet.
Hinge forward at the hips while keeping a flat back.
Hinge until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Push your hips back forward until you are in a standing position.

results.name: Band Glute Kickback
steps: Get into a quadruped position. Loop the band around both of your wrists and one of your feet.
Extend your knee and hip straight back until you feel like contraction in the glutes.
Flex at the knee until back in the starting position.

results.name: Band Leg Press
steps: Lay flat on the ground with your head by the anchor point of the band, which should be
to
inches above your head
Place the band around your midfoot and extend at the knees and hip.

results.name: Band Spanish Squat
steps: Anchor a band to a stable point.
Place the loops of the band behind your knees.
Perform a normal squat and extend your knees against the band at the top.

results.name: Band Pullthrough
steps: Anchor the band to the lowest point possible. Straddle the band and then grab with both hands.
Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Push your butt back until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings. Then extend the hips back into the starting position.

results.name: Band Hip Abduction
steps: Attach the band around your ankle. Stand with feet hip-width apart, feet facing forward, and hands on hips.
Lift your right leg away from your body to the side, keeping your knee straight. This is your starting position.

Maintaining proper form, move your right leg as far to the side as you can, keeping your left leg planted firmly on the ground. Hold for a second and then return your right leg to the starting position.

results.name: Band Hip Adduction
steps: Attach a band to a stable anchor point, such as a door handle or post.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and place the band around your ankles.
Keeping your feet together, move your legs out to the sides and then back to the midline of your body. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

results.name: Mini-Band Clamshell
steps: Loop band above knees, lie on side knees bent.
Keep feet together, lift top knee upward.
Lower slowly without rotating hips backward.

results.name: Banded Side Walks
steps: Place a band either just below or above your knees.
Get into a quarter squat position.
Step side to side without letting there be any slack in the band to keep tension on the band.

results.name: Band Goblet Squat
steps: Stand with a shoulder width grip. Both feet should be on the band with the band looped over both hands.
Push your butt back and also break at the knees.
Try to hit parallel depth (bottom of your leg should be parallel with the ground). If you can't tell your squat depth, then try squatting in front of a mirror and watch your form.

results.name: Band Standing Good Morning
steps: Stand on band and loop it around upper back, feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at hips while keeping back flat and slight bend in knees.
Squeeze glutes to return to standing, maintaining band tension throughout.

results.name: Mini Band Plank Glute Kickback
steps: Loop band around feet, hold high plank.
Extend one leg back, squeezing glute at top.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.

results.name: Mini Band Clamshell Raise
steps: Loop band above knees, lie on side knees bent.
Keep feet together, lift top knee upward, push bottom knee into ground, and push your hips forward.

results.name: Mini Band Side Laying Hip Abduction
steps: Loop band above knees, lie on side legs straight.
Lift top leg upward without rotating hips.
Lower slowly, maintaining constant band tension.

results.name: Mini Band Laying Glute Bridge Abduction
steps: Loop band above knees, lie on back knees bent.
Lift hips into bridge, hold top position.
Pulse knees outward against band, controlling tension.

results.name: Mini Band Laying Hip Abduction
steps: Loop band above knees, lie on side legs straight.
Lift top leg upward without rotating hips.
Lower slowly, keeping tension on band.

results.name: Mini Band Glute Bridge
steps: Loop band above knees, lie on back knees bent.
Drive through heels, lift hips until fully extended.
Lower slowly, keeping knees pressed outward.

results.name: Mini Band Fire Hydrant
steps: Loop band above knees, start on hands and knees.
Lift one knee outward, keeping hips level.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.

results.name: Mini Band Jump Squat
steps: Loop band above knees, stand feet shoulder width.
Squat down, knees pushed outward against band.
Explode upward into jump, land softly and reset.

results.name: Mini Band Single Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand on band with one foot, hinge at hips.
Keep back flat, opposite leg extended behind.
Drive hips forward to return upright.

results.name: Mini Band Squat
steps: Loop band above knees, stand shoulder width.
Sit back and down, pushing knees outward.
Stand up, maintaining tension on band.

results.name: Mini Band Side To Side
steps: Loop band above knees, slight athletic stance.
Step laterally, keeping knees pushed outward.
Continue stepping side to side under control.

results.name: Mini Band Walking Side To Side
steps: Loop band above knees, slight squat stance.
Step laterally, keeping constant outward knee pressure.
Continue walking side to side under control.

results.name: Mini Band Standing Glute Kickback
steps: Loop band around ankles, stand tall holding support.
Extend one leg backward, squeezing glute.
Return slowly without arching lower back.

results.name: Mini Band Standing Hip Abduction
steps: Loop band around ankles, stand tall holding support.
Lift one leg out to side, torso upright.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.

results.name: Band Good Morning
steps: Anchor the band at hip level. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Push your hips back while keeping your back flat until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.

results.name: Band Pullover
steps: Place the band just above our level. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Push your hips back slightly. Extend and flex at the shoulder joint.

results.name: Mini Band Overhead Fly
steps: Loop bands around wrists,, arms extended overhead.
Pull arms outward in arc motion.
Return slowly, controlling tension throughout movement.

results.name: Band Half Kneeling Single Arm Pulldown
steps: Kneel facing anchor with band overhead, holding the end of the band in one hand.
Keep torso tall and pull elbow down toward your hip.
Squeeze lat at the bottom, then return arm slowly to starting position.

results.name: Band Seated Single Arm Pulldown
steps: Sit facing anchor with band overhead, holding handle in one hand.
Pull elbow down toward your hip while keeping chest tall.
Squeeze lat at the bottom, then return slowly to full stretch.

results.name: Band Seated Pulldown
steps: Sit facing anchor with band overhead and arms extended.
Pull elbows down toward ribs while keeping chest lifted.
Squeeze lats at the bottom, then return slowly to full stretch.

results.name: Band Kneeling Pulldown
steps: Kneel facing anchor with band overhead and arms extended.
Pull elbows down toward ribs while keeping chest tall.
Squeeze lats at the bottom, then return slowly to full stretch.

results.name: Band Pallof Press
steps: Place the band at an anchor point that is shoulder height. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Start with your fingers interlocked around the band and your fists connected to your chest.
Extend at the elbows pressing the band away from your body until your elbows are fully extended.

results.name: Band Wood Chopper
steps: Anchor band at shoulder height. Stand sideways, feet shoulder-width, slight knee bend.
Grip band with both hands, arms extended.
Pull across body, rotating torso.

results.name: Band Side Bend
steps: Stand with band anchored low on one side, holding handle at hip.
Lean torso away from anchor, keeping hips and legs still.
Contract obliques to return upright, maintaining smooth control.

results.name: Band Pallof Press To Wood Chopper
steps: Stand sideways to band, hold handle at chest, and brace your core.
Press arms straight forward, resisting rotation.
Rotate torso and pull band across body in a wood chopper motion, then return.

results.name: Band Pull Apart
steps: Grab the band with a shoulder width grip. Point your arms straight in front of you.
Retract your shoulder blades and shoulder joint until the band taps your chest.

results.name: Band Face Pull
steps: Anchor the band at eye level. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Use an overhand grip with both hands. Pull the band to the bridge of your nose flaring your elbows out.

results.name: Band High Face Pull
steps: Start with a band anchored to a high point. Stagger your stance.
Pull the band to the bridge of your nose.

results.name: Band Rear Delt Fly
steps: Start by standing between the two anchored bands with your feet shoulder-width apart and the bands positioned at a high point.
Grasp the ends of each band with your hands, keeping your palms facing each other.

Keeping your arms slightly bent and your back straight, slowly pull the bands away from your body until your arms are extended straight out to the sides. Hold for a second, then slowly release back to the starting position. Repeat for desired reps.

results.name: Mini Band Bent Over Rear Delt Row
steps: Stand on band, hinge forward with neutral spine.
Row elbows out wide, squeezing shoulder blades back.
Lower slowly, maintaining bent-over position.

results.name: Mini Band External Rotation
steps: Anchor band, elbow at side bent
degrees.
Rotate forearm outward, keeping elbow pinned.
Return slowly to start, controlling resistance.

results.name: Mini Band Pull Apart
steps: Hold band at shoulder height, arms straight.
Pull hands apart, squeezing shoulder blades together.
Return slowly, maintaining tension throughout.

results.name: Band Shrug
steps: Place the band under your feet. Stand upright.
Elevate your shoulder blades and then depress back to the starting position.

results.name: Band Horizontal Shrug
steps: Anchor the band at shoulder height. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Retract your shoulder blades straight back in schools. Then protract to the starting position.

results.name: Band Skullcrusher
steps: Anchor a band to a stable point.
Face away and begin with your elbows bent and fists by your temples.
Extend your elbows until your triceps contract.

results.name: Band Overhead Tricep Extension
steps: Stand with one or both feet on band. Go up and over your head with the band to the starting position.
Flex and extend your elbows.

results.name: Mini Band Tricep Pushdown
steps: Loop band around wrists.
Keep one hand at shoulder height and press your other hand down.

results.name: Band Overhead Press
steps: Stand between the two anchored bands, grasp them with an overhand grip, and position the bands at shoulder level.
Brace your core and push the bands overhead, fully extending your arms.
Lower the bands back to shoulder level, keeping your core engaged and arms straight. Repeat for desired number of reps.

results.name: Band Rapunzel Pushdown
steps: Anchor the band to a high point and face away. Hold the band with both hands, placing your hands shoulder-width apart and keeping your elbows close to your body.
Slowly extend your arms downward, keeping your elbows close to your body. Push the band down as far as you can, feeling the contraction in your triceps.

results.name: Band Single Arm Pushdown
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band with your right hand, with your arm at your side.
Flex and extend your elbow.

results.name: Single Arm Rapunzel Pushdown
steps: Stand with a band anchored to a high point. Face away from the band. Hold the loop in one hand.
Keep your elbow tucked in to your side. Extend your elbow. When you extend, don't let your upper arm raise. The band should land over your shoulder.

results.name: Band Tricep Kickback
steps: Anchor the band to a stable point.
Hinge forward. Extend and flex at the elbow.
